title: #BTC/USDT ANALYSIS
body:
Bitcoin is facing rejection from the horizontal supply zone of the rectangular channel and is currently trading within the horizontal demand zone.

The Ichimoku cloud is acting as a key resistance barrier above the current price action.

A successful hold of the demand zone could trigger a rebound, while a breakdown below the channel support could lead to further correction in the market.

title: #USDT DOMINANCE ANALYSIS
body:
USDT Dominance is consolidating within the descending triangle pattern and is currently trading below the resistance trendline.

The Ichimoku cloud is acting as a key resistance barrier above the current price action.

We need to wait for a solid breakout or breakdown to confirm the next directional move.

It’s important to note that USDT Dominance often exhibits an inverse correlation with the broader cryptocurrency market.
